summary: Cleanup removed lifecycle state after SIGTERM delivery without confirming Chromium exit; fixed with pidfd signaling and bounded exit confirmation.
Background heartbeat persistence could race cleanup and reclaim a newly active browser; fixed with synchronous lease updates and reconnect refresh under lock.
PID validation and signaling used separate unstable PID operations; fixed by opening and signaling through a pidfd after exact process validation.
Standalone cleanup had no periodic invoker and therefore could not run without MCP; fixed with an enabled 30-minute systemd user timer.
Chromium rewrites root argv into one space-separated procfs field so production roots were undiscoverable; fixed with dual-form parsing and a regression test.
Predictable /tmp registry and lock opens followed symlinks and used permissive modes; fixed with no-follow owned regular-file checks, random atomic temp files, and mode 0600.
Corrupt registry reads and failed atomic writes silently became empty or successful state; fixed to fail closed and propagate errors.
